LanguageData.Raven_Building_Conveyor.label: [Raven] Conveyor Belt
LanguageData.Raven_Building_Conveyor.description: Transports virtual items on the logic layer selected by the current build icon, and does not connect with other layers.
LanguageData.Raven_Building_ConveyorSplitter.label: [Raven] Conveyor Splitter
LanguageData.Raven_Building_ConveyorSplitter.descript: Receives items from the yellow direction and splits them fairly among up to three other actually connected directions on the current logic layer.
LanguageData.Raven_Building_ConveyorMerger.label: [Raven] Conveyor Merger
LanguageData.Raven_Building_ConveyorMerger.descriptio: Receives items from up to three same-layer conveyors from the yellow directions, merges them fairly, and outputs them from the green direction.
